title: Integrated arm demonstration at prize spec (Gen-3+ prize-closing gate)
acceptance: Arm executes a directed position sequence anywhere within a 50 nm cube at <=0.1 nm accuracy and >=1000 accurate motions/s for >=60 consecutive seconds (the literal Device-1 spec).

title: Derive required effective stiffness vs thermal-noise positioning bound
acceptance: Bound table: sigma=3 nm -> k>=~0.46 pN/nm; sigma=0.1 nm (prize) -> k>=~414 pN/nm; sigma=0.03 nm -> k>=~4.6 N/m (kBT=4.14 pN.nm @300K).

title: Simulate as-designed lever positional variance at 300 K
acceptance: Simulated sigma_RMS <= 3.0 nm for nominal Gen-1 lever; 95% CI reported.

tool/method: cryo-EM class averaging + smFRET dye-geometry assay
title: Measure as-built positional/angular dispersion (cross-validated)
acceptance: Measured sigma <= 3 nm (Gen-1 precursor); prize grade is 0.1 nm (Gen-3+); cryo-EM vs smFRET agree within band.

tool/method: Control-theoretic variance-reduction bound vs loop bandwidth & sensor noise
title: Feedback-cooling / dwell-averaging analysis to reach sub-nm effective placement
acceptance: Proof that closed-loop effective placement variance reaches target given measured loop bandwidth; else flag stiffening required. Jointly budget the averaging window N against the >=1000 motions/s rate floor (A2.4) and report the achievable (precision, rate) Pareto point, not precision alone: averaging N~100-400 to reach 1-2 nm caps rate at ~16-630/s unless cold-stiffening feedback or a 3-sigma noise read is invoked.

title: Repeatability: return-to-target over >=100 actuation cycles
acceptance: 3-sigma cycle-to-cycle repeatability <= target; no monotonic drift beyond tolerance.

tool/method: Poisson-Boltzmann electrostatics + Euler-Bernoulli beam, closed form
title: Electromechanical model: stroke & blocking force vs gate voltage (HfO2-gated DNA lever)
acceptance: Analytic stroke >=~3 nm (aspirational ~10 nm; acceptable if solidly repeatable or closed-loop-corrected) and blocking force >= 100 pN at gate field below HfO2 breakdown. Operating point: low-ionic-strength (spermidine Mg2+-free folding <1 mM, or ~2-3 mM Mg2+ with UV thymine-dimer/CPD covalent crosslinking) so the drive field is not screened away; spermidine-folded origami is documented stable under high field pulses. Note: lever length/stroke is NOT the dominant positioning-noise term -- JOINT COMPLIANCE is; budget stiffness at the joints and trade stroke vs amplification freely.

title: Field-driven deflection simulation incl. ionic screening
acceptance: Simulated stroke >=~3 nm (aspirational ~10 nm), force >= 100 pN at <=2 V; screening length consistent with buffer. Evaluate stroke at the low-screening operating point (Mg2+-free / low-Mg + crosslink), not 10-20 mM Mg2+: the longer Debye length there preserves the work-stroke AND unscreens the FET sensor (A7).

tool/method: HfO2 ALD gate + DNA-origami lever; FET / high-speed AFM readout
title: Fabricate gated electrode + tethered lever; measure voltage-displacement curve
acceptance: >=5 nm reversible stroke; hysteresis < 20%; reversible over >=10^3 cycles.

title: Actuation bandwidth / cutoff frequency measurement
acceptance: Small-signal bandwidth >= 1 kHz (matches the prize floor of >=1000 positioning motions/s); roll-off characterized.

title: Dielectric reliability: field across HfO2 below breakdown over duty cycle
acceptance: Operating field <= 50% of HfO2 breakdown; projected MTTF > program duration.

title: Backup-actuation trade study (electrochemical / electrowetting / dipole-field)
acceptance: >=1 backup mechanism meets A2 thresholds, de-risking single-point reliance on electrostatics.

tool/method: Screw theory / Kutzbach criterion rank test
title: Mobility / DOF proof for parallel (delta-type) molecular manipulator
acceptance: >=3 independently controllable translational DOF; mechanism non-singular at home pose.

title: Workspace & singularity map within 100 nm envelope
acceptance: Reachable workspace covers the required 50 nm cube motion volume (per rules); singularity-free core >= X%; device envelope within 100 nm cube.

title: cryo-EM confirmation that as-assembled geometry matches design
acceptance: Assembled geometry within tolerance of CAD; correct topology in >= threshold of particles.

title: Tooltip grab/release energetics for a defined cargo
acceptance: Binding deltaG strong enough to hold under thermal load yet releasable by commanded actuation; window quantified.

title: Demonstrate controlled pick-and-place of a nanoscale object
acceptance: Deterministic placement at commanded site (tolerance per spec) with success rate >= threshold over >= N trials.

tool/method: DFT reaction-path with catalyst; retraction-force estimate
title: Low-force tooltip bond-formation feasibility (Track-2 mechanosynthesis link)
acceptance: Candidate single-site/catalytic reaction with retraction force <= ~100 pN (vs 3-6 nN uncatalyzed); barrier feasible.

tool/method: Crossbar/multiplex addressing proof + capacitive crosstalk bound
title: Unique-addressability proof for M actuators via E electrodes (crosstalk bound)
acceptance: Each actuator uniquely addressable; worst-case crosstalk < sensing/actuation noise margin.

title: Closed-loop control simulation (plant = A2 actuator + A7 sensor)
acceptance: Steady-state error <= target, gain/phase margins adequate, stable under modeled noise.

title: Closed-loop demonstration on a single actuator (command->move->sense->correct)
acceptance: Closed-loop positional sigma reduced >= 2x vs open loop; the 'critical missing element' demonstrated.

tool/method: System ID / ML surrogate trained on sensor feedback
title: AI control-model identification & held-out validation
acceptance: Model predicts displacement within tolerance on held-out set; generalizes across devices.

title: Per-actuator power & local-heating budget
acceptance: Local temperature rise < limit at operating duty; aggregate array heat tractable.

title: Electrode electrochemical/electromigration stability at operating bias
acceptance: Operating bias within electrochemical window; projected electrode life > program.

tool/method: Noise model (thermal/1-f/shot) + minimum detectable displacement derivation
title: Information-theoretic SNR bound for FET charge-displacement sensing vs bandwidth
acceptance: Closed-form min-detectable-displacement(B); explicit PASS/FAIL on sub-3 nm at >=1 kHz. The SNR bound MUST be computed at the actuator's operating ionic strength: in 10-20 mM Mg2+, screening attenuates the sensed charge ~10-50x; the low-Mg / Mg2+-free + crosslink operating point is required to reach SNR>=10 at >=1 kHz.

title: Device simulation of FET sensitivity to lever charge vs distance/screening
acceptance: Simulated SNR >= 10 at sigma=3 nm and B >= 1 kHz. Simulate at the low-ionic-strength operating point; report Debye length and sensed-charge attenuation vs Mg2+ (and spermidine) concentration.

tool/method: Fabricated FET adjacent to charged lever; lock-in
title: Measure FET displacement-sensing SNR vs speed
acceptance: Measured SNR meets derived bound at operating bandwidth; sub-3 nm resolved at >=1 kHz.

tool/method: Coupled Poisson-Boltzmann + FET electrostatics vs ionic strength
title: Coupled actuation-stroke + FET-sense SNR vs ionic strength (operating-window proof)
acceptance: Solve the coupled Poisson-Boltzmann problem for the gated lever + adjacent FET as ONE system vs ionic strength: show an operating window (candidate: spermidine Mg2+-free folding <1 mM, or ~2-3 mM Mg2+ with UV/CPD covalent crosslinking) that SIMULTANEOUSLY delivers actuator stroke >=~3 nm (aspirational ~10 nm; repeatable or closed-loop-correctable) / force >=100 pN AND FET charge-sensing SNR >=10 at >=1 kHz. Report Debye length, work-stroke, and sensed-charge attenuation across the Mg2+/spermidine range. This jointly resolves the actuator(needs ions)-vs-sensor(needs low screening) conflict raised in review.

title: Envelope proof: assembled arm bounding box <= 100 nm
acceptance: Assembled manipulator fits <=100 nm cube; off-board control electrodes & anchoring substrate are EXCLUDED from the envelope (rules interpretation confirmed).

title: Structural rigidity / mechanical mode analysis
acceptance: Lowest relevant mode stiffness consistent with A1 stiffness bound; no floppy modes in workspace. Identify the dominant compliance term (joint compliance, not lever length) and budget stiffness at the joints.

title: Operating-environment demonstration (declared medium/temperature)
acceptance: Device operates to spec in the declared, prize-admissible environment; environment documented.

title: Integrated 8-bit adder demo (<=50 nm; exhaustive 65,536 inputs; bump output)
acceptance: Adder returns correct 8-bit sum (overflow discarded) for all 65,536 (2^16) input pairs, output as raised nm-scale bumps on an atomically precise level surface; device <=50 nm; produced by arm-class positional assembly.

title: Formal equivalence of adder netlist to reference 8-bit adder
acceptance: Equivalence PROVEN for all 8-bit input pairs (exhaustive/symbolic).

tool/method: Architecture device-physics simulator (QCA engine / SET / SPICE-like)
title: Device-level simulation reproduces full truth table with noise margin
acceptance: 100% correct sums in sim; logic-state separation > k.kBT margin at operating T.

title: Single-primitive device-physics simulation (bistability & switching energy)
acceptance: Primitive bistable; switching energy > kBT.ln2 by required margin at operating T. Reliability floor: the switching-barrier target for correct logic is ~15-30 kBT (bit-error-rate over a full 8-bit add), NOT the kBT.ln2 erasure (Landauer) floor; state the operating temperature this implies (room-T vs cryogenic).

tool/method: APM fabrication (STM H-depassivation donor / molecular switch) + transport
title: Fabricate & characterize a single primitive (one gate/cell)
acceptance: Single primitive demonstrates reproducible switching with margin; matches B2.1.

title: Bit-error-rate vs energy/temperature bound (Landauer + noise)
acceptance: BER per gate low enough that full 8-bit add succeeds with required probability. Use the ~15-30 kBT reliability barrier (not kBT.ln2) as the BER basis; if room-temperature margins are infeasible, declare cryogenic operation explicitly.

title: Area-closure place-and-route proof within 50 nm cube
acceptance: All ~37 XOR-equivalent (or 94 basic) gates + interconnect + bump-output transducers fit within 50 nm cube at chosen pitch.

title: Crosstalk / coupling simulation between adjacent devices
acceptance: Worst-case neighbor coupling < state-separation margin from B2.1.

title: I/O scheme proof (16-bit input via allowed modality; 8-bit output as surface bumps)
acceptance: Input via an allowed modality (acoustic/electrical/optical/diffusive-chemical/mechanical-single-axis); 8-bit output (overflow discarded) rendered as raised nm-scale bumps on an atomically precise level surface, SPM-readable.

title: Demonstrate 1-bit full-adder slice (input set + output read)
acceptance: 1-bit full adder renders correct sum & carry-out as surface bumps for all 8 input combinations; building block validated.

title: Energy/heat per addition & integrity budget
acceptance: Energy/op and heat within limits for the declared throughput.

tool/method: Area/energy/temperature budget model across candidate primitives
title: Architecture trade study & feasibility down-select
acceptance: Down-select >=1 primitive (molecular QCA / donor-SET / molecular-switch crossbar / mechanical rod-logic) that is positionally assemblable AND topographically readable and closes budgets for ~37 XOR-gate-equivalent (94 basic) within 50 nm; DNA strand-displacement ruled out on size/speed.

title: Yield-budget proof: max tolerable per-step defect rate for >=32 good devices
acceptance: Per-step yield target derived for N steps to deliver 32 devices at confidence c (e.g., 99%); architecture flagged if infeasible.

title: Hierarchical self-assembly yield simulation (staged folding/binding)
acceptance: Predicted correctly-assembled fraction >= threshold consistent with C1 budget.

title: Measure bulk assembly yield (gel / AFM / cryo-EM particle classification)
acceptance: Measured correctly-formed fraction >= threshold; defect modes catalogued.

title: Selection/purification to obtain 32 spec-conforming devices
acceptance: 32 devices isolated, each independently passing SEG-A (and SEG-B) acceptance AND able to survive destructive testing by judges (no hero-device reuse).

title: Device-to-device reproducibility distribution across 32 copies
acceptance: All 32 devices within spec band on key metrics; distribution reported.

title: [Roadmap link] Self-replication / exponential scale-up beyond x32 (Gen-3)
acceptance: Documented as NDI Gen-3 path (hierarchical convergent assembly); OUT of prize scope (rules: self-replication NOT required) but in roadmap.

title: Metrology adequacy proof: tool resolution < required tolerance per measured quantity
acceptance: Each measured quantity assigned a tool whose resolution beats its tolerance (cryo-EM ~few A; smFRET 2-8 nm; AFM 3-8 nm gap); 0.1 nm prize accuracy flagged as a metrology challenge.

title: Screening design: power analysis for bulk ensemble vibration screen
acceptance: Bulk screen sized to detect target stiffness/displacement effect at >=80% power; throughput estimated.

title: Single-molecule AFM force/displacement on down-selected designs
acceptance: Best designs' force/displacement match simulation within tolerance; precise characterization recorded.

title: Automated acceptance-test harness: instrument output -> ASM JSON -> assertion
acceptance: Given raw instrument file + node spec, harness emits reproducible PASS/FAIL; makes empirical leaves machine-verifiable.

title: Theory-of-operation completeness & independent-rebuild check
acceptance: Submission package complete per Foresight rules; independent rebuild reproduces a passing device.

title: Fabricate e-beam-patterned electrode array at required pitch & registration
acceptance: Electrode array at required pitch with registration <= tolerance (EBL ~75 nm feature floor; sub-feature alignment strategy documented).

title: Anchoring design: site-specific attachment occupancy & orientation model
acceptance: Predicted correct-orientation occupancy >= threshold; mis-orientation modes enumerated.

title: Measure anchoring yield & orientation (cryo-EM / FRET)
acceptance: Measured correct-orientation occupancy >= threshold; consistent with E2.1.

tool/method: Loop-delay/stability budget (sensor BW + compute + actuator BW)
title: Real-time control-loop latency & stability budget
acceptance: End-to-end loop latency yields adequate phase margin at target control bandwidth.

title: AI control model: train on sensor feedback, validate on held-out
acceptance: Model meets held-out error tolerance; supports closed-loop in A5.

title: Array-addressing scalability proof (wiring vs N actuators)
acceptance: Addressing scheme scales to target array size within wiring & crosstalk budget.

tool/method: Silica coating and/or UV/covalent crosslinking of DNA/protein
title: Silicified / covalently-crosslinked bio structure
acceptance: Make the Gen-2 bio structure survive dehydration/vacuum without denaturing: SILICIFICATION penetrates DNA origami and raises Young's modulus ~10x (100 MPa -> 1 GPa), stable without salt buffers and at elevated temperature; and/or COVALENT crosslinking (UV/thymidine, oligolysine) stabilizes origami to ~90 C and in pure salt-free water. The stabilized structure also survives the [application obligation] salt-free clean

title: Fully-inorganic NEMS templated / cast by bio-NEMS
acceptance: Use Gen-2 bio-NEMS (in fluid) to template/CAST a fully-inorganic NEMS mechanism: DNA molds cast metal/semiconductor parts to sub-5 nm replicating the mold; 3D metal/oxide/semiconductor frameworks via DNA-programmable templating are demonstrated. The crux is JOINT/HINGE fidelity - the assembled inorganic mechanism's joints must be bound/constrained correctly. Extend to protein-assembler positioning: ~2-3 nm engineered-protein nanomachines (crosslinked joints) place pre-fabricated stiff inorganic members (CNTs, piezoelectric nanowires) into the target mechanism; joint/hinge fidelity is the crux until inorganic joints become mechanosynthesizable. (Joint material is an open design variable; leading candidate is engineered proteins used as the linkages between inorganic members.)

tool/method: Electrostatic comb/gap, piezo, or electrothermal actuation
title: Vacuum-native actuator layer (non-DNA)
acceptance: Replace DNA-electrostatic actuation (needs water/ions) with a vacuum-native actuator - electrostatic comb/gap drive, piezo, or electrothermal - delivering the required force/stroke/bandwidth at the manipulator scale in vacuum (the standard regime for NEMS actuators/resonators).

tool/method: Stabilize -> rinse -> critical-point/freeze dry -> pump-down sequence
title: Fluid -> vacuum environmental transition interface
acceptance: Define the explicit fluid->vacuum transition (stabilize -> salt-free rinse -> critical-point/freeze dry -> pump-down) that the stabilized structure survives, and capture its impact on the program sequence (likely DELAYS CMOS integration) as a controlled systems-engineering interface.

tool/method: Map vacuum regime onto the the application track fluid obligations
title: Vacuum payoff proof (relaxes the fluid obligations)
acceptance: Quantify the vacuum payoff: in-line electrical gate-sweep test is valid (no ~1 nm Debye screening), there is no aqueous mobile-ion source, dry vdW returns to full strength (16-48 pN peel / 1e2-1e3 kBT pin), and there is no capillary dry-down - so vacuum operation relaxes/retires [application obligation] (wet pin), [application obligation] (mobile-ion barrier-vs-probe) and [application obligation] (staged wet/dry loop), and the Round-5 in-buffer-on-live-gat

tool/method: Gen-2 fluid bio-NEMS fabricating an inorganic Gen-3 substrate
title: Bootstrap: Gen-2 builds the Gen-3 vacuum substrate
acceptance: Demonstrate the generational handoff: Gen-2 fluid bio-NEMS manufacture the Gen-3 vacuum-operating substrate out of CMOS-like materials (Si/SiO2/SiN), validating that the fluid generation bootstraps the vacuum generation.

tool/method: Coarse-grained/MD origami stiffness + electrostatic voltage-controlled-spring + thermal spectrum
title: Gen-1 actuator + lever + thermal-noise model
acceptance: Model the Gen-1 stack (patterned electrode / high-k dielectric / soft polymer / DNA-origami Class-3 lever) as a voltage-controlled spring: predict force-displacement (target 100 nm displacement, 20 pN at the load), the Class-3 amplification, and the thermal-noise spectrum (~+-20 nm raw) -> the closed-loop precision achievable (1-2 nm in a 20 nm volume).

tool/method: Fold + TEM/AFM validate; electrostatic actuation; FET closed-loop
title: Gen-1 closed-loop actuator demonstration (the true first bench gate)
acceptance: Fold the DNA-origami Class-3 lever and validate by TEM/AFM; electrostatically actuate (100 nm displacement / 20 pN at load); sense position with an adjacent MOSFET (charged DNA backbone modulating the gate); CLOSE THE LOOP (the critical missing element of Iteration 1); achieve 1-2 nm precision in a 20 nm volume despite ~+-20 nm raw thermal noise. This is the foundational gate the entire program pr Stroke figures reconciled: ~100 nm is the Class-3 lever-amplified COARSE displacement; ~5-10 nm is the fine working stroke; ~20 nm is the closed-loop working volume. Operate at the low-ionic-strength point (spermidine / low-Mg + CPD crosslink).

title: Gen-1 addressable actuator array
acceptance: Demonstrate a multi-actuator array with individual addressing by voltage routing to patterned electrodes (display/memory-pixel-like; no mechanical selectivity), with independent per-actuator closed-loop control - the bridge to the the scaled manipulator array.

tool/method: De-novo protein design (RFdiffusion/ProteinMPNN) + stiffness/thermal model on origami scaffold
title: Gen-2 protein-stiffened / functional NEMS model
acceptance: Model protein-augmented NEMS: de-novo proteins (RFdiffusion/ProteinMPNN, Baker-lab class) docked at origami handles (~200 addressable points/tile) predicted to reduce thermal noise to +-2-5 nm and add stiffness/durability, with a functional element (motor / switch / enzymatic active site) positioned to ~Angstrom.

tool/method: Protein-on-origami assembly + characterization on the Gen-1 bus
title: Gen-2 protein-augmented NEMS demonstration
acceptance: Demonstrate de-novo proteins docked at origami handles reaching +-2-5 nm thermal noise with improved stiffness/durability and a functional element (motor/switch/enzymatic active site) positioned to ~Angstrom, actuated and sensed on the Gen-1 electrostatic+FET bus.

tool/method: Stiffness-wall calculation: required vs achievable torsional stiffness
title: Gen-3 stiffening-gap proof (toward sub-nm)
acceptance: Prove the stiffening design closes the gap between measured DNA-origami hinge/torsional stiffness (far too low) and k ~ 0.41 N/m required for sub-nm (0.1 nm) placement (vs only ~0.46 pN/nm for 3 nm) - the gating physics for the prize-grade arm (SEG-A) ONLY. Dense-pitch placement does NOT require this: the commercial midpoint hits its tolerance via kinematic-stop registration (~1-3 nm), not sub-nm stiffness. The route that closes the gap is likely INORGANIC (vacuum/inorganic branch, SEG-I), not protein stiffening alone. Quantify required-vs-achievable and the design (protein and/or inorganic) that closes it. Route update: pursue sub-nm NOT by stiffening a protein arm to k~0.41 N/m, but by using ~2-3 nm protein-component assemblers (crosslinked, engineered protein joints) to POSITION stiff inorganic members (CNTs, piezoelectric nanowires); protein joints persist until mechanosynthesis-competent inorganic joints exist. Quantify required-vs-achievable for the assembler+inorganic-member stiffness, not the bare protein. (Joint material is an open design variable; leading candidate is engineered proteins used as the linkages between inorganic members.)

title: Gen-3 sub-nm closed-loop placement demonstration
acceptance: Demonstrate sub-nm closed-loop placement with the protein-stiffened structure - the precursor tier to the Gen-3+ Feynman-prize-grade arm (SEG-A) and the enabler of dense-pitch placement precision.
